instruction: Access slide 2, then set its title as 'Project Timeline' using blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1.0);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate to slide 2 (index 1) and set title to 'Project Timeline' with blue color. Evaluator checks both text content and color RGB values. Custom getter extracts slide title properties, custom metric compares text and color with partial scoring (50% for text match, 50% for color match).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 50% for correct title text, 50% for correct blue color (RGB: 0, 0, 255)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is CORRECT: Properly identifies title placeholder using shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE (impress.py:39-46). This ensures the getter reads the actual title shape, not just the first text shape.
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('text') and expected.get('color_rgb') without incorrectly looking for expected['rules'].
Coverage is complete - evaluator checks ALL instruction requirements: title text 'Project Timeline' and color RGB [0, 0, 255].
Partial scoring logic is sound and fair - 50% for text match, 50% for color match.
Postconfig is appropriate - saves file with Ctrl+S and waits 1.5s total (0.5s + 1.0s), adequate for LibreOffice to complete save operation.
Getter has proper error handling - returns {'error': 'no_title_placeholder'} when no title placeholder is found (impress.py:50).
Minor note: Getter returns color_rgb as tuple while expected is list, but Python element-wise comparison in metric (lines 30-32) works correctly for both formats.
